basic_profile.bio: I'm a backyard BBQ enthusiast living in Saskatoon. I work as a systems analyst by day and spend my weekends perfecting the art of smoking meats. I love sharing tips and learning from other grill masters in the community. I'm usually online in the evenings after 7 PM and on weekends. I'm single and enjoy exploring local food spots with friends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, having studied at the University of Saskatchewan. My interest in BBQ and smoking meats is self-taught, fueled by countless hours of online research, YouTube tutorials, and trial and error. I'm also tech-savvy, frequently integrating new gadgets into my cooking setup.
